eyebrow.zh: 加载前先验 · 结构对不对 · 后门藏没藏
eyebrow.en: Pre-load check · structure intact · no hidden backdoor

headline.zh:
agent 加载国产权重前
先把投毒的挡在门外
headline.en:
Before your agent loads a CN-model weight
keep the poisoned one out

sub.zh: 加载前一条命令扫一遍：校验权重内部结构对不对得上模型该有的样子，再揪出藏在文件里的可执行后门。
sub.en: One command, before load: verifies the weight's internal structure matches the model's expected layout, then surfaces any executable backdoor hidden inside the file.

title.zh: 结构对不对，加载前就知道
title.en: Know the structure is right before you load

body.zh: 国产模型每周推送权重制品，却没人能告诉你这份文件的内部结构是不是该模型该有的样子。加载前按模型逐一套结构基准——张量在不在、形状对不对、有没有被悄悄改过。
body.en: CN labs ship a fresh weight artifact every week, and nothing tells you whether this file's internal layout is the one that model is supposed to have. Before load, each model is checked against its own structural baseline — are the tensors there, are the shapes right, has anything been quietly tampered with.

chips: › 不加载完整权重 · 几秒扫完

title.zh: 藏在文件里的后门，加载前揪出来
title.en: Surface backdoors hidden in the file, before load

body.zh: 通用扫描器只盯可执行代码片段，认不出一个被改了结构的国产权重。加载前同时扫一遍文件里有没有藏可执行后门——那些会在加载时偷偷跑起来的东西。
body.en: Generic scanners only chase executable code snippets and can't tell a structurally tampered CN weight from a normal one. Before load, the file is also swept for executable backdoors — the kind that quietly run the moment you load it.

chips: › 单文件 · 整目录一次扫完

title.zh: 一条命令，加载前的安全门
title.en: One command, the safety gate before load

body.zh: 不用搭流水线、不用写脚本。指向刚拉下来的权重制品，一条命令同时给出结构与后门的结论——干净才放行，可疑就非零退出，机器可读结果直接接进 CI。
body.en: No pipeline to set up, no script to write. Point it at a freshly pulled weight artifact and one command returns a structure + backdoor verdict — clean passes, suspect exits non-zero, and the machine-readable result drops straight into CI.

chips: › 结构 + 后门一次出结论

headline.zh: 把加载前那一道门，收敛成一条命令
headline.en: Collapse the pre-load gate into one command

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、无付费墙。加载前验明正身这一步，永不设墙。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, no paywall. The pre-load check is never gated.
